note: Portable source-built math provider for native Darwin x86_64 and ARM64. This is OpenLibm, not an Apple macOS release component.
local_changes: include/openlibm_fenv_aarch64.h: feholdexcept clears FPSR exception status with FE_ALL_EXCEPT, not the FPCR enable mask.

include/openlibm_fenv_amd64.h: fesetenv restores an identical volatile automatic copy, preserving const inputs despite QEMU 10.1 helper_fldenv incorrectly probing its source as MMU_DATA_STORE (https://github.com/qemu/qemu/blob/v10.1.0/target/i386/tcg/fpu_helper.c#L2425). Actual x87/MXCSR restoration is unchanged; feupdateenv uses this same helper.
